subject: Plan and batch producer for Heltäckande markslagskarta 2024
description: Tobias asked on 2026-11-03 for a plan PR and a batch producer, written and tested locally, for a wall-to-wall 2024 land-cover map of the eleven demo areas, labelled "Heltäckande markslagskarta 2024" (never "förberäknad"). Scope: docs/plans/lclu_2024_coverage.md; scripts/produce_lclu_coverage.py, which runs every window through the same LcluService path as on-demand maps under its own output root, sharded over parallel pods (CPU cost is CPU x time), resumable, with inputs deleted per window, fill windows where the service refuses a lattice cell, a seam statistic and per-area mosaic COGs with a coverage manifest; tests/lclu/test_coverage.py on synthetic windows; k8s/lclu-coverage-2024-job.yaml as an Indexed Job template validated with dry runs only. Not in scope: running anything on the cluster (each step needs Tobias's go), the serving route, the page layer, XYZ tiles, model scores of any kind. Review: Codex.
